verdict.rationale: The 01's own docs and README list "control third-party software" and code execution on the user's computer, which touches on cross-app desktop control. Nothing shows GUI-level operation such as clicking, typing, or keyboard shortcuts across the OS. Missing for 10: documented mouse-click and keystroke/shortcut automation, evidence of OS-wide (not single-app) GUI control, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
